tips.text: Rank one Vasto to 30 before crafting; the second can stay at rank 0.
Keep one other Secondary, rank 0 is fine, before you press Build; the Foundry refused one player whose only Secondaries were the two Vastos.
Grab the 2 Orokin Cells while the Vastos build, then rank one Vasto and craft.
Expect a low-effort craft; players call the Akvasto middling and prefer the Prime.
